welcome.title: Intermittent fasting, made fun
welcome.body: Tap start when you stop eating. FastFast keeps time and tells you when you hit your goal.

habit.title: Streak & Habit strength
habit.body: Every completed fast keeps your streak and fills your habit bar. Longer fasts fill it faster.

shield.title: Shields — rest days that keep your streak
shield.body: Stay consistent or finish a long fast to earn shields. On a rest day, a shield protects your streak automatically.

pixel.title: A colorful year
pixel.body: Every day is a pixel. Log your mood and weight, and see your whole year in one picture.

health.title: Listen to your body
health.body: FastFast is not a substitute for medical advice. If you are pregnant, have a medical condition or plan to fast longer than 48 hours, talk to a doctor. Stop right away if you feel dizzy or unusually unwell.
